rdf:Description.rdfs:label: source
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element is a single or a collection of source files.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: draft

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasDynamicLink
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element dynamically links in each `to` Element, during a LifecycleScopeType period.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: highAutomation
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Level 4 - High automation. The system performs parts of its mission without external intervention.
Specifies a country code where a software service is hosted.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: invokedBy
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element was invoked by the `to` Agent, during a LifecycleScopeType period (for example, a /Build/Build element that describes a build step).
A statement of how, or for what purpose, an item or artifact is intended to be used.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: glue
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [GLobal Unique Enterprise (GLUE) Identifiers](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/draft-ietf-spice-glue-id/), as defined by the IETF Internet-Draft, is expressed as a GLUE URI, a Uniform Resource Identifier that standardizes the representation of existing organizational entity identifiers.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: vulnerableCodeNotPresent
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The product is not affected because the code underlying the vulnerability is not present in the product.
Provides an ExternalMap of Element identifiers.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: md4
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: MD4 message-digest algorithm, as defined in [RFC 1186](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/rfc1186/).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: archive
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element is an archived collection of one or more files (.tar, .zip, etc.).
Specifies the SPDX License List version in which this license or exception identifier was deprecated.
A value used in a CdxPropertyEntry name-value pair.
Describes a certain part of a file.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: blake2b256
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: BLAKE2b algorithm with a digest size of 256, as defined in [RFC 7693](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/rfc7693/) Section 4.
Safety risk level.
Describes the specific responsibility of a Role.
Results of general safety risk assessment of the AI system.
The boundary definition is used to define boundaries.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: file
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The file represents a single file (default).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: deployed
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: SBOM provides an inventory of software that is present on a system. This may be an assembly of other SBOMs that combines analysis of configuration options, and examination of execution behavior in a (potentially simulated) deployment environment.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: support
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to the software support channel or other support information for a package.
Domain in which the AI package can be used.
The result of applying a hash algorithm to an Element.
The Boundary Definition Process refers to the process class used to produce boundaries.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: runtime
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A relationship has specific context implications during the execution phase of an element.
The amount or measure of a bulk product.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasRoleIn
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element has a role in the `to` Element. The use of the hasRoleIn is constrained to `RoleRelationship` classed relationships.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: amberStrict
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Limited distribution - organization only. The dataset shall be shared only with specific organizations on a need-to-know basis.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: filesystemImage
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element is a file system image that can be written to a disk (or virtual) partition.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: securityPolicy
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to instructions for reporting newly discovered security vulnerabilities for a package.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: mavenCentral
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to a Maven repository artifact. The artifact locator format is defined in the [Maven documentation](https://maven.apache.org/guides/mini/guide-naming-conventions.html) and looks like `groupId:artifactId[:version]`.
It is the authoritative or credible entity, document, or body of knowledge that provides the meaning of a type, ensuring accuracy, context, and standardization.
Describes if a given file is a directory or non-directory kind of file.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasPrerequisite
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element has a prerequisite on each `to` Element, during a LifecycleScopeType period.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: core
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The element follows the Core profile specification.
An SPDX version 2.X compatible verification method for software packages.
A location where a package or an item is being dropped off or delivered.
Records the biases that the dataset is known to encompass.
An individual human being.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: active
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: In use.
Identifies the full text of a LicenseAddition.
RequirementVerification class defines the base properties of a verification.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: ai
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The element follows the AI profile specification.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: clear
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Unlimited. Subject to standard copyright rules, the dataset may be shared freely, without restriction.
Identifies the full text of a LicenseAddition, in SPDX templating format.
Type of the model used in the AI software.
Energy consumed when training the AI model that is being used in the AI system.
Type of data in a dataset.
This property is used to denote the root Element(s) of a tree of elements contained in a BOM.
A distinct unit representing a requirement, as used in systems, software, and hardware engineering.
A product specification (product spec) is a detailed document that outlines the technical, functional, and design requirements of a product.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: altWebPage
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to an alternative web page.
Specifies the algorithm used for calculating the hash value.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: bic
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Business Identifier Code (BIC), also known as SWIFT-BIC or SWIFT code, is a unique 8 or 11-character alphanumeric code standardized by [ISO 9362](https://www.iso.org/standard/84108.html) to identify financial and non-financial institutions (e.g., `BBWCUS33`).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: other
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Other exploit catalogs.
Protocols which support authentication.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: securityAdvisory
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to a published security advisory (where advisory is defined per [ISO 29147:2018](https://www.iso.org/standard/72311.html)) that may affect one or more elements, e.g., vendor advisories or specific NVD entries.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: no
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Indicates absence of the field.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: nli
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [Natural Location Identifier (NLI)](https://eccma.org/enli-eccma-natural-location-identifier/) is a 14- or 15-character alphanumeric string standardized by [ISO 8000-118](https://www.iso.org/standard/85428.html) that uniquely identifies a three-dimensional geographic point location. The identifier is generated from geodetic coordinates and elevation data. For electronic storage, the `ISO.NLI:` prefix shall be retained (e.g., `ISO.NLI:41TS8M-A8ELTQ-H2`).
An Agent responsible for product identification, such as an original equipment manufacturer (OEM).
A substitute for a URI.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: video
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Data is video based, such as a collection of movie clips.
Regulation represents a rule or directive maintained by an authority.
Availability of dataset.
Preprocessing steps that were applied to the raw data to create the given dataset.

Products out of specification require a resolution action. This is the action of resolution.
Provides a CVSS version 4 assessment for a vulnerability.
roleQualification specifies the requirements, criteria, or conditions that must be met for an entity to be considered qualified to fulfill a particular role.
Identifies an external Element used within an SpdxDocument but defined external to that SpdxDocument.
Portion of an AnyLicenseInfo representing this version, or any later version, of the indicated License.
Defines the byte range in the original host file that the snippet information applies to.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: purchaseOrder
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to a purchase order for a package.
Specifies the exploit catalog type.
Anonymization methods used.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: md6

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: webpage
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A Uniform Resource Locator (URL) that can be used to locate a resource, as defined in [RFC 9110](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/rfc9110/) Section 4.2.1 or Section 4.2.2. It may include an optional fragment identifier as specified in [RFC 3986](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/rfc3986) Section 3.5.
Specifies an Extension characterization of some aspect of an Element.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: draft
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Not yet finalized; under development or review.
The valid state for DefinedStateProcess.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: development
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The artifact is in active development and is not considered ready for formal support from the supplier.

rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Specifies the CVSS base, temporal, threat, or environmental severity type.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: reviewable
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A requirement is ready for formal review by stakeholders for a specific use.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: isni
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [International Standard Name Identifier (ISNI)](https://isni.org/page/what-is-isni/) is a unique identifier used to distinguish the public identities of parties involved in the creation, production, and distribution of media content. Standardized by [ISO 27729](https://www.iso.org/standard/87177.html), it consists of 16 characters—15 digits plus a final check character—and is often represented as a URI, such as `https://isni.org/isni/000000012146438X`.
Specifies the CVSS qualitative severity rating of a vulnerability in relation to a piece of software.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: log
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Time-stamped records capturing system or operational data recorded as usually as a response to specific triggers in a specified environment.
A contact point from an Artifact to an Agent.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: inconclusive
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Inconclusive refers to a result or outcome from a verification, test, or analysis that cannot be clearly classified as either positive (successful, pass) or negative (failed, reject). An inconclusive result means there was not enough clear evidence, data, or signal to make a definitive determination, and further investigation or additional testing is necessary. An inconclusive result always shall need a comment on it.
How the dataset was collected.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: delegatedTo
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Agent is delegating an action to the Agent of the `to` Relationship (which shall be of type invokedBy), during a LifecycleScopeType period (e.g. the `to` invokedBy Relationship is being done on behalf of `from`).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: sourceArtifact
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to an artifact containing the sources for a package.
Information about the relationship between two Elements.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: fullAutomation
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Level 5 - Full automation. The system is capable of performing its entire mission without external intervention.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasDocumentation
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element is documented by each `to` Element.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasVariant
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Every `to` Element is a variant the `from` Element (`from` hasVariant `to`).
RoleRelationship represents a relationship between an entity holding a role and the scope or context in which that role applies. The givenRole property specifies the role assigned.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: text
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Data consists of unstructured text, such as a book, a Wikipedia article (without images), or a transcript.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: other
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Used when the type does not match any of the other options.
Artifact representing a serialization instance of SPDX data containing the definition of a particular Element.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: file
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element is a single file which can be independently distributed (configuration file, statically linked binary, Kubernetes deployment, etc.).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: sha512
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: SHA-2 with a digest length of 512, as defined in [RFC 6234](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/rfc6234/).

Energy consumed when finetuning the AI model that is being used in the AI system.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: obsoleted
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Superseded or not valid at present.
Information related to massOfHardware physical hardware.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: green
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Community wide. The dataset shall be shared only within a community of peers and partners.
Enumeration of valid profile identifiers.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: reportedBy
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Designates a `from` /Security/Vulnerability was first reported to a project, vendor, or tracking database for formal identification by each `to` Agent.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasProvidedDependency
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element has a dependency on each `to` Element, dependency is not in the distributed artifact, but assumed to be provided, during a LifecycleScopeType period.
A planned location where a good, product, or material is stored.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: availableFrom
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element is available from the additional supplier described by each `to` Element.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: specification
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A specification is a detailed document (or set of documents) that describes the requirements, design, behavior, or other characteristics of a system, component, or process so that all stakeholders have a clear, unambiguous reference.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: sha3_224
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: SHA-3 with a digest length of 224, as defined in [FIPS 202](https://csrc.nist.gov/pubs/fips/202/final).

Provide context for a relationship that occurs in the lifecycle.

ISCC can be used in conjunction with other schemes, such as DOI, ISAN, ISBN, ISRC, ISSN and ISWC. A standard ISCC-CODE is build from multiple ISCC-UNITs. Each unit serve a different purpose. An ISCC-CODE typically look like `ISCC:KACT4EBWK27737D2AYCJRAL5Z36G76RFRMO4554RU26HZ4ORJGIVHDI`.
EvaluationResult is the result of an evaluation.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: endOfSupport
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: There is a defined end of support for the artifact from the supplier. This may also be referred to as end of life. There is a validUntilDate that can be used to signal when support ends for the artifact.
Unit in which energy is measured.
The product lifecycle phase, the requirement is applicable for.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: categorical
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Data that is classified into a discrete number of categories, such as the eye color of a population of people.

rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element treats each `to` Element as a data file. A data file is an artifact that stores data required or optional for the `from` Element's functionality. The `hasDataFile` relationship does not imply a dependency. Examples of data files include database files, index files, log files, AI model files, calibration data files, temporary files, and backup files. For configuration data, build input data, build output data, test artifacts, test datasets, and training datasets, the more specific relationship types `configures`, `hasInput`, `hasOutput`, `hasTest`, `testedOn`, and `trainedOn` shall be used, respectively.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: contains
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element contains each `to` Element.
Identifies who or what supplied the artifact or VulnAssessmentRelationship referenced by the Element.
Links a vulnerability and elements representing products (in the VEX sense) where a fix has been applied and are no longer affected.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: noAssertion
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Makes no assertion about the field.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: clickthrough
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Dataset is not publicly available and can only be accessed after affirmatively accepting terms on a clickthrough webpage.
An Individual Value for Element representing a set of Elements of unknown identity or cardinality (number).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: critical
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: When a CVSS score is between 9.0 - 10.0.
Class that describes an action that has occurred.
Temporary endeavor with a beginning and an end and that must be used to create a unique product, service or result.
Denote whether a CVE is present in an exploit catalog.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: staticAnalysisReport
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to a static analysis report for a package.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: secureSoftwareAttestation
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to information assuring that the software is developed using security practices as defined by [NIST SP 800-218 Secure Software Development Framework (SSDF) Version 1.1](https://csrc.nist.gov/pubs/sp/800/218/final) or [CISA Secure Software Development Attestation Form](https://www.cisa.gov/resources-tools/resources/secure-software-development-attestation-form).
Property that describes the digest of the build configuration file used to invoke a build.
An Organization representing the SPDX Project.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: decommission
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A relationship has specific context implications for a product's retirement and/or decommissioning.
Link to the project contract.

rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Certificate Revocation List, or CRL, is a list of revoked certificates that is downloaded from the Certificate Authority (CA).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: verifiedBy
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Requirement that has verification (test, review, analysis etc.) details defined in the `to` /FunctionalSafety/RequirementVerification.

The DefinedType class associates a specific type with its defined source.
CreationAction represents an event of product creation.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: medium

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: eolNotice
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to the End Of Sale (EOS) and/or End Of Life (EOL) information related to a package.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: doesNotAffect
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` /Security/Vulnerability has no impact on each `to` Element. The use of the `doesNotAffect` is constrained to `/Security/VexNotAffectedVulnAssessmentRelationship` classed relationships.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: locatedAt
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: `from` Element located at a specific `to` Location. A time period is optional.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: function
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Simulation the function of the hardware.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: sha3_384
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: SHA-3 with a digest length of 384, as defined in [FIPS 202](https://csrc.nist.gov/pubs/fips/202/final).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: providesSupportFor
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Agent provides support for each `to` Artifact. The use of the `providesSupportFor` type is constrained to `SupportRelationship` classed relationships.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: falcon
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [FALCON](https://falcon-sign.info/falcon.pdf)

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: inspection
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A thorough examination or checking of documentation, records, processes, or systems to confirm compliance or adherence. An inspection needs to have a defined set of acceptance criteria (e.g. a checklist), a documentation of roles involved in the inspection (e.g. to document the inspector's independence) and a clear documentation of when and how it was performed.
Provides the license under which the SPDX documentation of the Element can be used.
A reference to a resource identifier defined outside the scope of SPDX 3 content that uniquely identifies an Element.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: privacyAssessment
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to a privacy assessment for a package.
Provides a reference number that can be used to understand how to parse and interpret an Element.
Provides information about the primary purpose of the software artifact.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: update
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A relationship has specific context implications for a product update.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: noAssertion
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: No assertion can be made about the completeness of the relationship.

assignedBy identifies the agent that grants or assigns the role to the target element.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: regulation
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A mandatory legal specification issued by a governmental or regulatory authority. Compliance is enforceable by law.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: syntactic
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Data describes the syntax or semantics of a language or text, such as a parse tree used for natural language processing.
References the Element on the left-hand side of a relationship.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: conformsTo
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element conforms to each `to` /FunctionalSafety/Assumption or Specification.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: copiedTo

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: usesTool

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: autonomous

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: trainedOn

Software provided as a service over a network.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: observation
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Documentation of direct monitoring or witnessing of the demonstration of processes, tests, or any kind of system responses during a specified timeframe under specified environmental conditions.

Confidentiality level.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: pretrainedOn

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: fail

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasAddedFile

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasRequirement
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element has a requirement on each `to` Element, during a LifecycleScopeType period.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: exploitCreatedBy

rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Every `to` Element is a specification for the `from` Element (`from` hasSpecification `to`), during a LifecycleScopeType period.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: model
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element is a machine learning or artificial intelligence model.
